evidence.title: Framer: AI web design tool for responsive websites

name: Framer
summary: The Framer Motion component API page; the URL now redirects to Framer's AI web design site.
description: The URL for the Framer Motion component API now redirects to Framer's design page, which presents Framer as an AI web design tool: a freeform canvas where agents generate and refine layouts, components and interactions, then publish without code. Developer docs for code components live under /developers.
